texto.es: Cuéntanos qué necesitas arreglar; una foto del problema ya nos ayuda a orientarte.

items.quote: I've used the Handy Beard multiple times in the last year. He has been a huge help making many repairs to my new home.  He works quickly, cleanly and independent of supervision.  I trust him in my home anytime whether I'm home or not.  Does excellent work at a reasonable price.

Anthony installed my attic stairs in my garage. He was fast professional and incredibly detailed. They work great and look like they were always there. Perfect person to hire for handyman services. Would 100% hire again.

Anthony from Handy Beard is amazing. Our walls look incredible and the refinishing on our kitchen cabinets is outstanding. Anthony is polite professional and pays attention to every detail.  Left our home spotless.
